summary: CreatorOS v2 testing — Backend: 15/15 pytest passed (auth session/me/logout, competitors list/radar/gaps, stripe status shape, youtube 503, strategy generate+list+get via Claude, v1 endpoints still work). Frontend: Login screen renders correctly (testID login-google-btn + 'The CEO in your pocket.' headline + all 4 bullets). Unauthenticated / redirects to /login. Dashboard 'Take action' section renders with quick-strategy and quick-competitors cards. Profile screen renders Stripe + YouTube integration rows and Sign out. /strategy renders horizon pills (30/60/90) + Generate plan button. CRITICAL BUG: /competitors throws a runtime RedScreen 'ReferenceError: r is not defined' at app/competitors.tsx:29 — there is an orphan duplicated Array.from(...) block outside the ringPolygon function (lines 27-30 of competitors.tsx) that references the parameter `r` which is only in scope inside ringPolygon. This crashes the screen completely. Also: tapping the dashboard quick-action cards (quick-strategy / quick-competitors) does NOT trigger navigation — URL stays at /. Direct URL navigation to /strategy works fine; /competitors red-screens regardless. The quick-strategy card click failing is suspicious — possibly Pressable onPress is wired to a non-interactive wrapper.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime ReferenceError: 'r is not defined' — duplicated orphan Array.from((_, i) => ...).join(' ') block on lines 27-30 (after ringPolygon arrow returns) references `r` which is only a param of ringPolygon. Causes RedScreen on /competitors. Fix: delete lines 27-30 (the orphan duplicate). Reference: /app/frontend/app/competitors.tsx:27-30

Tapping quick-strategy or quick-competitors does not navigate (URL stays at /). Direct goto('/strategy') renders correctly; /competitors red-screens regardless. The onPress on these Pressables (testIDs quick-strategy / quick-competitors) appears not to push routes. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — minor, repeated across app.

action_items: FIX competitors.tsx red screen: remove the duplicate orphan `Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>{ const a=angle(i); return `${cx+Math.cos(a)*r},${cy+Math.sin(a)*r}` }).join(' ');` block (lines 27-30, just after ringPolygon's return). The genuine function ringPolygon already does this correctly inside its own scope. This is purely a stray duplicated block left over from refactor.

FIX dashboard quick-action card onPress: ensure quick-strategy and quick-competitors call router.push('/strategy') and router.push('/competitors') respectively (or that the testID is on the Pressable that owns onPress, not its inner View).
Optional: silence the recurring 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning by migrating to style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: competitors.tsx has clear duplicate code at lines 27-30 — looks like a copy/paste leftover; ringPolygon is correctly defined on 27-31, then 32-35 repeat the inner body outside any function. TypeScript/ESLint should have flagged 'r is not defined' at build — recommend enabling strict TS in CI.

Backend code looks clean: auth uses Bearer token resolution + TTL session; competitors radar/gaps normalize correctly; strategy persists with id+_id stripped on read. PROJECTION {_id: 0} used consistently — no ObjectId leaks.
auth.py /auth/me returns 401 with 'Missing bearer token' as expected. _aware() helper correctly handles naive datetimes from Mongo. TTL index on expires_at means expired sessions auto-purge.

integrations.py stripe gracefully catches StripeError and any Exception — returns {connected:false, mode:null, error:...} as specified. YouTube returns 503 with friendly message when YOUTUBE_API_KEY missing — verified.
strategy.py correctly strips markdown code fences before json.loads and surfaces 502 on parse failure. Persists with str uuid id.

success_rate.frontend: 70% — login + redirect + dashboard 'Take action' + /strategy direct + profile all pass; /competitors red-screens; dashboard quick-action card tap navigation broken

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes competitors.tsx (delete orphan block at lines 27-30) and dashboard onPress wiring, retest: (1) /competitors renders radar + Biggest gaps (testID gap-revenue_mtd must be first row), (2) tapping data-testid=quick-strategy from dashboard navigates to /strategy, (3) tapping data-testid=quick-competitors navigates to /competitors. Strategy plan generation (Claude) takes ~12s — already verified at backend level. Use synthetic token: localStorage.setItem('creatoros_session_token','ui-test-token-e95127ab') OR insert a new one via script.
rca_of_issue: competitors.tsx RedScreen: orphan code block at module/function scope references `r` which only exists as parameter of ringPolygon arrow above. Likely introduced during a refactor where the contents of ringPolygon were pasted twice — first inside the arrow (correct), then again as a free statement (broken). Reproduction: load /competitors with any auth → RedScreen 'r is not defined' at competitors.tsx:29. Mitigation: delete the duplicated block (the 4 lines after `}).join(' ');`). Verified that ringPolygon itself (lines 22-26 in source) is intact and used by the rings rendering.
